name: Leave Ledger (synthetic example)

requirements.description: An employee can submit a leave request with start date, end date and type; the request is stored with status 'pending'.
A request whose end date is before its start date is rejected with a clear error and nothing is stored.
A manager can approve or reject a pending request; an already decided request cannot be decided again.
An employee's remaining balance decreases by the working days of each approved request and never below zero.
Only a manager of the employee's team can decide that employee's requests.
Data written by one run is read back unchanged by the next run (persistence across restarts).

checks.requirement: REQ-001: submit and store a pending request
REQ-002: end before start is rejected and not stored
REQ-003/REQ-005: manager decision changes status once
REQ-003: a decided request cannot be decided again
REQ-005: a manager of another team is refused
REQ-006: write in one process, read in another
